```json
 "topology": "Complementary CS (inverter) with resistive vout-vin load",
 "rationale": "GBW>=240MHz into 0.5pF needs gm>=0.75mS. Driving the NMOS and the PMOS from vin reuses ~55uA, giving gm~1.3mS. A 10k resistor from vout to vin sets Rout. That gives gain ~gmR-1 ~ 10 (20dB) and f3db ~ 1/(2pi R CL) ~ 30MHz. Each device's width is set so its current at Vgs=0.75 / Vsg=1.05 matches the budget. Output DC then sits near 0.9V. Small vdsat in weak/moderate inversion should allow about 1.5V of swing. Power ~(55u+Iref)*1.8 <= 125uW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (55e-6, 35e-6, 62e-6),   # NMOS branch current at the operating point
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "R":      (10e3, 7e3, 13e3),       # vout->vin load resistor (sets gain and BW)
    "vout_t": (0.9, 0.8, 1.05),        # target output DC level
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I, Ln, Lp, R, vt = p["I"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["R"], p["vout_t"]

    # Currents at the operating point: the PMOS supplies In plus the resistor current (vout->vin).
    In = I
    Ip = I + (vt - vin) / R

    # NMOS: W chosen so that Id(Vgs=vin, Vds=vout_t) = In. Id scales linearly with W.
    Wr = 10.0
    on = lut.op("n", Wr, Ln, vin, vt)
    Wn = max(0.42, Wr * In / on["Id"])
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vt)

    # PMOS: W chosen so that Id(Vsg=VDD-vin, Vsd=VDD-vout_t) = Ip (magnitudes).
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wr, Lp, VDD - vin, VDD - vt)
    Wp = max(0.42, Wr * Ip / op_["Id"])
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, VDD - vin, VDD - vt)

    # Capacitance estimates, taken from a reference sizing at the same gm/Id.
    rn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, In, vds=vt)
    rp = lut.size("p", max(min(op_["gm_id"], 16), 3), Lp, Ip, vds=VDD - vt)
    cout = rn.cdd + rp.cdd + rn.cgd + rp.cgd

    # ibias sink: NMOS diode carrying IREF (no other use).
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wn, 3), Ln)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(Wp, 3), Lp)
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # Small-signal performance
    gm = on["gm"] + op_["gm"]
    gds = on["gds"] + op_["gds"]
    G = 1.0 / R
    A = (gm - G) / (G + gds)
    f3 = (G + gds) / (2 * PI * (cl + cout))
    gbw = A * f3
    power = VDD * (Ip + iref)

    # Swing: limited by the saturation edges of each device.
    swing = VDD - on["vdsat"] - op_["vdsat"] - 0.05

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vt,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
